# Vendored: OpenAI's `apply_patch` reference implementation

`apply_patch.py` is copied **unmodified** from
[`openai/openai-cookbook`](https://github.com/openai/openai-cookbook/blob/main/examples/gpt-5/apply_patch.py)
at commit `263b2d5b7b63836c4ea30ee9709e65b7a50cbf6f`
(SHA-256 `278dd0f644733d9575326b307f8bb8b0414bf04446e24671f2833db76c6a0adb`),
under the MIT license in `apply_patch.LICENSE`. It applies the
`*** Begin Patch` / `*** End Patch` format OpenAI's models emit for a tool
named `apply_patch`; `../patch-format.ts` imports it as text and
`../runtime.ts` writes it into the sandbox beside a patch that needs it.

Do not edit this file. To update it, copy the new upstream version over it,
record the new commit and hash here and in `APPLY_PATCH_SCRIPT_SHA256`, and
re-check the contract `runtime.ts` relies on: the script reads the patch from
stdin, prints `Done!` on success, prints a rejected patch's reason on stdout
and still exits 0, and needs the `pydantic` package, whose pin is
`TERMINAL_PYDANTIC_REQUIREMENT` in `../snapshot-manifest.ts`.
